result.title: A Generative Model of Contextual Integrity: Appropriate vs. Inappropriate Information Sharing
result.comment: Accepted as a main conference paper at NeurIPS 2026
result.summary: Contextual integrity (CI) holds that appropriate information flow depends on context-specific norms. The same disclosure may be appropriate in one context and inappropriate in another. We build a generative model of contextual integrity to study information sharing through simulated conversations. Two actors played by large language models exchange messages, with one holding private information and the other seeking it. We examine how sharing and refusal vary with the situation, the holder's decision logic, disposition, and the underlying language model. Actors shared information with the rightful recipients when it was needed, but also disclosed it to people who were not entitled to receive it. The model provides a way to study how disclosure and refusal develop through conversation as the situations and the actors vary.

AI.brief_summary: 该文构建「语境完整性」的生成式模型：由两个 LLM 扮演信息持有者与索取者进行对话，考察情境、持有者决策逻辑与模型差异如何影响信息披露与拒绝。
AI.relevance_reason: 研究的是社交语境下信息流动的规范适当性，不涉及视觉或多模态内部表示、推理状态生成与视觉证据使用，也未提供可核查的状态更新、贡献分配或停止决策线索。
